raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows carry numeric region codes (01-04) instead of region names, so silver_customers has unexpected values. raw_region_map maps the codes to names (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so silver_customers can translate them and gold_region_daily will then pick up the corrected values.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
